item.title: product details
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
General Features

Zero Gravity Position – Full-Body Weight Offload

Inspired by NASA, this recline position aligns the body to reduce spinal pressure and maximize massage effectiveness.

Thai Stretch Massage – Deep Muscle Extension

Uses body-hugging airbags to grip and gently stretch your limbs and spine to improve flexibility and posture.

Auto Body Detection – Custom Fit for Every User

Sensors scan your height and shape to align rollers and airbags perfectly before every session.

6 Advanced Massage Techniques – With Dual Modes

4 core massage type offers two variations, give you 10 total style options:

  • Kneading I, II
  • Padding I, II
  • Rolling I, II
  • Tempo I, II
  • Wave
  • Acupressure

Key Features – At a Glance

  • Voice Control + Dual System (Manual & Touchscreen)
  • Zero Gravity Recline
  • Thai Stretch Massage
  • Headrest + Shoulder Airbags
  • Arm Massage (Tapping + Airbags)
  • Calf & Foot Airbags
  • Calf & Back Heating
  • Foot Rollers
  • Adjustable Ankle Flipping
  • Body Detection Sensor
  • 6 Massage Techniques (with 10 Mode Variations)
  • Built-in Physiotherapy Music (Relax, Sleep, Recovery)
  • Bluetooth Music Connectivity
  • Ergonomic Cushioning & Backrest Pad
  • Upright and Reclining Position Control

Dual Control System

Touchscreen + Manual Remote

Operate with ease using the responsive display panel or the hand-held controller, it’s on you.

Voice Control – Just Speak, Relax Starts

Built-in voice assistant listens to your command means no need to move a finger during your massage.

Built-in Physiotherapy Music – Designed for Mind-Body Calm

Choose from Sleep, Relax or Recovery mode, soundtracks are tuned to help brain and body enter rest mode quicker.

  • 3D Multi-Dimensional Massage: Deeply targets pressure points on your soles to relieve tension and improve circulation.
  • Air-Compression Therapy: Airbags gently compress thighs to feet for reducing swelling and relaxing muscles.
  • Heat Therapy: Provides warmth up to 45°C to ease muscle stiffness and improve blood flow.
  • 3 Massage Modes: Switch between vibration, kneading or a combination for customized relief.
  • Instep Pressure Massage: Helps your soles fit rollers perfectly for effective shiatsu massage.
  • Calf and Thigh Massage: Relaxes larger muscle areas with shiatsu heads for heavy legs or fatigue.
  • Adjustable Intensity: Choose from three levels (Light, Medium, Strong) to match your comfort needs.
  • Hygienic Design: Detachable cloth lining ensures easy cleaning for shared use.
  • Adjustable Base: Two base stands let you find the perfect angle while sitting or reclining.

item.title: Essence 3D Massage Chair Product Details
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Key Features for Your Maximum Relaxation

Full-Body Massage Rollers

Feel the magic of a deep, lifelike massage that feels just like human hands, easing away all your tension.

Full Body Scanning

The chair adapts to you, mapping your unique shape to hit all the right spots and provide a truly personalized massage.

Adjustable Range of Massage Rollers

Whether you like a gentle touch or a deep tissue massage, you can set the rollers to match your preference perfectly.

Rejuvenate Thermal Therapy

Let the soothing warmth melt away your muscle aches and improve your circulation for a refreshed feeling.

18 Automatic Programs

From relaxation to muscle relief, choose from 18 expertly designed programs to fit your needs.

Intelligent AI Voice Control

Talk to your chair! Just say what you need, and it will adjust the settings for you.

Air Compression Massage

Gentle air compression works wonders on your calves, thighs, hips, waist, and back, boosting blood flow and reducing stiffness.

Why Choose the Essence Massage Chair?

  • Complete Escape
  • Targeted Relief
  • Feel-Good Circulation
  • Soothe, Recover, Recharge
  • Stress, Meet Your Match
  • Totally Customized
  • Voice-Activated Magic
  • Luxury Every Day

Key Features for Your Maximum Relaxation

Sole “GuaSha” Therapy

Give your feet some love with traditional “GuaSha” therapy, perfect for deep relief and stimulation.

Wireless Charging Station

Keep your devices powered up with the built-in wireless charging station, so you can relax without interruptions.

Legrest Extension up to 14 cm

No matter your height, the leg rest extends to fit you perfectly, ensuring maximum comfort.

Zero Gravity Massage Mode

Experience the feeling of weightlessness as your legs are elevated to reduce spinal pressure and enhance relaxation.

Stereo Bluetooth Speaker Connectivity

Immerse yourself in your favorite tunes with high-quality Bluetooth speakers, creating a complete sensory experience.

Music Therapy

Enhance your relaxation with calming music that syncs with your massage for a holistic wellness experience.

Quick Control + USB Fast Charging Port

Easily accessible controls and a fast-charging USB port make it convenient to manage your settings and keep your devices charged.

Size Guide Category: Massage Chair Share:

The ARISTO 4D Massage Chair by Zero Healthcare is a smart full-body wellness system designed to relax, realign and recharge you right at your place. Its advanced  massage technology, dynamic ankle flipping mechanism and custom intensity controls work together to release tension, support recovery and improve daily comfort. From head to feet, ARISTO adapts to your needs and offers relief where your body needs it most.

Signature Features – Explained Simply & Specifically

Ankle Flipping Adjustment – Precision Fit for Every Leg Type

Traditional leg massage systems are fixed. ARISTO features a dynamic ankle flipping mechanism that manually or automatically adjusts the ankle rest angle.
– This system works through pivoted brackets and jointed actuators that allow up-down flipping movement of the ankle section.
– The flipping helps align your ankles to match your sitting height and leg shape which increases contact during calf and foot massage.
– Combined with foot rollers and airbags to ensure complete 360° lower leg therapy.
Your feet and calves don’t just rest they get actively treated.

Arm Tapping + Air Compression – Stimulation, Not Just Squeeze

Unlike basic air-only chairs, ARISTO combines mechanical tapping units under the armrest with strategically placed airbags.
– The tapping motors simulate rhythmic tapping strokes to stimulate muscle reflexes.
– Simultaneously, airbags inflate and deflate in timed cycles, hugging your arms from wrist to elbow.
– The result is a balanced pressure and percussion combo that enhances blood circulation, reduces fatigue and loosens joint stiffness.
Perfect for those who type, lift or drive all day.

Back & Calf Heating – Heat That Heals Where It Hurts

ARISTO includes built-in carbon fiber heating pads behind the backrest and within the calf area.
– These pads emit far-infrared heat, which penetrates below the skin level to warm muscles from the inside out.
– This mechanism increases local blood circulation which helps with detoxification, and relieves tightness.
– The warmth activates gradually during your session to complement the massage pressure.
It’s not surface heat, it’s therapeutic warmth where your body needs it most.

Backrest Up & Down – Recline How You Like It

ARISTO comes with a motorized reclining system connected to the backrest frame.
– A quiet linear actuator lifts or lowers the backrest at the push of a button (or voice command).
– This allows the user to adjust from upright seated posture to near-horizontal recline.
– It’s not just about angle it’s about posture support, pressure relief and comfort during various activities like reading, watching or resting.
Your spine stays supported, no matter how far you lean back.

Wellness Benefits

  1. Eases back, shoulder, leg and arm pain
  2. Relieves stress, improves sleep quality
  3. Boosts blood circulation and flexibility
  4. Warms up tight muscles & reduces inflammation
  5. Encourages lymphatic drainage
  6. Helps regulate posture & spinal alignment
  7. Offers full-body support for daily recovery
  8. Great for desk workers, elderly users & athletes

Who Should Use It?

Ideal for:

  • Office workers with neck, shoulder or lower back stiffness
  • Athletes with sore muscles or post-training recovery needs
  • Elderly users with circulation or joint stiffness
  • Women facing leg fatigue or body soreness from standing work
  • People with sedentary lifestyles or poor posture
  • Individuals with stress, insomnia or anxiety-related tension

Best for These Specific Conditions

ARISTO is particularly suitable for:

  • Cervical & Lumbar Pain
  • Sciatica
  • Muscle Fatigue & Stiffness
  • Frozen Shoulder
  • Stress-Related Insomnia
  • Mild Osteoarthritis
  • Poor Leg Circulation (e.g. Edema, Fatigue)
    Including patients recovering from long-term muscular strain or minor spinal misalignments.
  • Description
  • Additional information
  • Reviews (1)

General Features

Zero Gravity Position – Full-Body Weight Offload

Inspired by NASA, this recline position aligns the body to reduce spinal pressure and maximize massage effectiveness.

Thai Stretch Massage – Deep Muscle Extension

Uses body-hugging airbags to grip and gently stretch your limbs and spine to improve flexibility and posture.

Auto Body Detection – Custom Fit for Every User

Sensors scan your height and shape to align rollers and airbags perfectly before every session.

6 Advanced Massage Techniques – With Dual Modes

4 core massage type offers two variations, give you 10 total style options:

  • Kneading I, II
  • Padding I, II
  • Rolling I, II
  • Tempo I, II
  • Wave

  • Voice Control + Dual System (Manual & Touchscreen)
  • Zero Gravity Recline
  • Thai Stretch Massage
  • Headrest + Shoulder Airbags

  • 6 Massage Techniques (with 10 Mode Variations)
  • Built-in Physiotherapy Music (Relax, Sleep, Recovery)
  • Bluetooth Music Connectivity
  • Ergonomic Cushioning & Backrest Pad
  • Upright and Reclining Position Control

Dual Control System

Touchscreen + Manual Remote

Operate with ease using the responsive display panel or the hand-held controller, it’s on you.

Voice Control – Just Speak, Relax Starts

Built-in voice assistant listens to your command means no need to move a finger during your massage.

Built-in Physiotherapy Music – Designed for Mind-Body Calm

Choose from Sleep, Relax or Recovery mode, soundtracks are tuned to help brain and body enter rest mode quicker.

  • 3D Multi-Dimensional Massage: Deeply targets pressure points on your soles to relieve tension and improve circulation.
  • Air-Compression Therapy: Airbags gently compress thighs to feet for reducing swelling and relaxing muscles.
  • Heat Therapy: Provides warmth up to 45°C to ease muscle stiffness and improve blood flow.
  • 3 Massage Modes: Switch between vibration, kneading or a combination for customized relief.
  • Instep Pressure Massage: Helps your soles fit rollers perfectly for effective shiatsu massage.
  • Calf and Thigh Massage: Relaxes larger muscle areas with shiatsu heads for heavy legs or fatigue.
  • Adjustable Intensity: Choose from three levels (Light, Medium, Strong) to match your comfort needs.
  • Hygienic Design: Detachable cloth lining ensures easy cleaning for shared use.
  • Adjustable Base: Two base stands let you find the perfect angle while sitting or reclining.

Why Choose D-Queen Spa?

Delivers fast relief for tired legs and feet.

Trusted by thousands for quality and durability.

Backed by a 1-year warranty for worry-free use.

item.title: Onyx 2D Massage Chair Sale Product Details
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
General Features

Full-body Massage Rollers:

The Onyx has a full-body massage rollers that put an even force on your shoulders, neck, back, waist, buttocks and feet. It minimizes the accumulation of tensions in the muscles, thus establishing a soothing feeling.

5 Auto Massage Programs

From among five customized programs (Kneading, Relax, Tuina, Strong and Sleep), you can select the one that suits your requirement whether you want to get relieve of stress or muscles soreness after a workout.

U-Shaped Head-rest Compression

A unique U-shaped head-rest provides gentle compression to relieve head and neck tension and helps alleviate headaches and promote relaxation.

Dynamic Air Compression

The air compression system has three levels of intensity that cover your body and you are allowed to adjust the pressure on areas of your choice, such as your lower back or thighs, for targeted relief.

Soothing Heat Therapy

Gentle heat is applied to your waist and arms to release tight muscles and boost circulation for a more soothing massage experience.

Comprehensive Foot Reflexology

The Onyx comes with a rotating “Gua Sha” rollers, acupressure calf rollers and airbag compression to provide a therapeutic massage that reduces foot pressure and improves overall foot health.

Forget These Problems

  • Muscles Tension
  • Stress and Anxiety
  • Headache and Migraines
  • Foot Swelling and Pain
  • Poor Circulation
  • Sleep Aid

General Features

Leg-rest Extension (Up to 15 cm)

It can suit different body sizes since there is an option of leg-rest extension to enable anyone to receive the full body massage according to one’s height.

Zero Gravity Mode

The Zero Gravity feature elevates your legs and reduces pressure on your body.

Bluetooth Speaker Connectivity

Enjoy your favorite music or podcasts while you relax with bluetooth speakers that connect to your smart device.

LED Screen Control Panel

The intuitive control panel lets you customize settings such as massage programs and intensity levels with ease. And soft LED lights create a calming atmosphere to enhance your relaxation.

Quick Control & USB Fast Charging Port

The Onyx includes a quick control feature on the armrest along with a USB charging port to keep your devices powered while you busy in relax.

High-Quality Synthetic Leather

Created from durable synthetic leather for luxurious look and long-lasting comfort feel.

item.title: Testimonials
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
What Our Customers Say

Testimonials

Discover how our customers experience comfort, relaxation, and everyday wellness through our trusted massage solutions.

Michal Psychiatrist

I recently added this luxury electric massage chair to my home, and it has completely changed the way I relax and unwind after work.

Mira Al-Sulaiti University Professor

We wanted something practical yet highly effective for daily relaxation, and this has truly become the perfect home wellness solution.

Alysha Geologist

The pressure and comfort feel perfectly balanced, providing noticeable muscle relief within just minutes while remaining compact and space-saving.

Mohd Rifaz Legal Expert

I purchased the ARISTO 4D Massage Chair for my home, and the experience has been exceptional and highly satisfying.

Hudson Pharmacist

I ordered the D-Queen SPA Foot Massager and was genuinely impressed, as it provides noticeable and soothing relief after long working hours.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Frequently Asked Questions

Are your products original and internationally certified?

Yes. We partner only with reputable global manufacturers and ensure compliance with international quality standards.

Do you offer delivery and installation services for your products?

Yes. We offer professional delivery and installation services across Qatar.

Do you offer corporate packages?

Absolutely. We provide customized wellness solutions for corporate offices, hospitality groups, and institutions.

What about warranty and support?

All products come with manufacturer warranty and dedicated local support through WellXTech.

Can I consult before purchasing?

Yes. Our specialists guide you in selecting the right product based on your wellness goals, space, and usage requirements.

item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.

We use Your Personal Data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, You agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

Interpretation and Definitions

Interpretation

The words whose initial letters are capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or in plural.

Definitions

For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

  • Account means a unique account created for You to access our Service or parts of our Service.
  • Affiliate means an entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, where "control" means ownership of 50% or more of the shares, equity interest or other securities entitled to vote for election of directors or other managing authority.
  • Company (referred to as either "the Company", "We", "Us" or "Our" in this Privacy Policy) refers to Well X Tech, Office # 201-204, Building No. 11, Barwaa Commercial Avenue, Doha, Qatar.
  • Cookies are small files that are placed on Your computer, mobile device or any other device by a website, containing the details of Your browsing history on that website among its many uses.
  • Country refers to: Qatar
  • Device means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cell phone or a digital tablet.
  • Personal Data (or "Personal Information") is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.We use "Personal Data" and "Personal Information" interchangeably unless a law uses a specific term.
  • Service refers to the Website.
  • Service Provider means any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Company. It refers to third-party companies or individuals employed by the Company to facilitate the Service, to provide the Service on behalf of the Company, to perform services related to the Service or to assist the Company in analyzing how the Service is used.
  • Usage Data refers to data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).
  • Website refers to Well X Tech, accessible from http://wellxtech.com/.
  • You means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service, as applicable.

Collecting and Using Your Personal Data

Types of Data Collected

Personal Data

While using Our Service, We may ask You to provide Us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify You. Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

  • Email address
  • Phone number

Usage Data

Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service.

Usage Data may include information such as Your Device's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that You visit, the time and date of Your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

When You access the Service by or through a mobile device, We may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device You use, Your mobile device's unique ID, the IP address of Your mobile device, Your mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browser You use, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

We may also collect information that Your browser sends whenever You visit Our Service or when You access the Service by or through a mobile device.

Tracking Technologies and Cookies

We use Cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on Our Service and store certain information. Tracking technologies We use include beacons, tags, and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze Our Service. The technologies We use may include:

  • Cookies or Browser Cookies. A cookie is a small file placed on Your Device. You can instruct Your browser to refuse all Cookies or to indicate when a Cookie is being sent. However, if You do not accept Cookies, You may not be able to use some parts of our Service.
  • Web Beacons. Certain sections of our Service and our emails may contain small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags, and single-pixel gifs) that permit the Company, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an email and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of a certain section and verifying system and server integrity).

Cookies can be "Persistent" or "Session" Cookies. Persistent Cookies remain on Your personal computer or mobile device when You go offline, while Session Cookies are deleted as soon as You close Your web browser.

Where required by law, we use non-essential cookies (such as analytics, advertising, and remarketing cookies) only with Your consent. You can withdraw or change Your consent at any time using Our cookie preferences tool (if available) or through Your browser/device settings. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

We use both Session and Persistent Cookies for the purposes set out below:

  • Necessary / Essential CookiesType: Session CookiesAdministered by: UsPurpose: These Cookies are essential to provide You with services available through the Website and to enable You to use some of its features. They help to authenticate users and prevent fraudulent use of user accounts. Without these Cookies, the services that You have asked for cannot be provided, and We only use these Cookies to provide You with those services.
  • Cookies Policy / Notice Acceptance CookiesType: Persistent CookiesAdministered by: UsPurpose: These Cookies identify if users have accepted the use of cookies on the Website.
  • Functionality CookiesType: Persistent CookiesAdministered by: UsPurpose: These Cookies allow Us to remember choices You make when You use the Website, such as remembering your login details or language preference. The purpose of these Cookies is to provide You with a more personal experience and to avoid You having to re-enter your preferences every time You use the Website.

For more information about the cookies we use and your choices regarding cookies, please visit our Cookies Policy or the Cookies section of Our Privacy Policy.

Use of Your Personal Data

The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

  • To provide and maintain our Service, including to monitor the usage of our Service.
  • To manage Your Account: to manage Your registration as a user of the Service. The Personal Data You provide can give You access to different functionalities of the Service that are available to You as a registered user.
  • For the performance of a contract: the development, compliance and undertaking of the purchase contract for the products, items or services You have purchased or of any other contract with Us through the Service.
  • To contact You: To contact You by email, telephone calls, SMS, or other equivalent forms of electronic communication, such as a mobile application's push notifications regarding updates or informative communications related to the functionalities, products or contracted services, including the security updates, when necessary or reasonable for their implementation.
  • To provide You with news, special offers, and general information about other goods, services and events which We offer that are similar to those that you have already purchased or inquired about unless You have opted not to receive such information.
  • To manage Your requests: To attend and manage Your requests to Us.
  • For business transfers: We may use Your Personal Data to evaluate or conduct a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution, or other sale or transfer of some or all of Our assets, whether as a going concern or as part of bankruptcy, liquidation, or similar proceeding, in which Personal Data held by Us about our Service users is among the assets transferred.
  • For other purposes: We may use Your information for other purposes, such as data analysis, identifying usage trends, determining the effectiveness of our promotional campaigns and to evaluate and improve our Service, products, services, marketing and your experience.

We may share Your Personal Data in the following situations:

  • With Service Providers: We may share Your Personal Data with Service Providers to monitor and analyze the use of our Service, to contact You.
  • For business transfers: We may share or transfer Your Personal Data in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of Company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of Our business to another company.
  • With Affiliates: We may share Your Personal Data with Our affiliates, in which case we will require those affiliates to honor this Privacy Policy. Affiliates include Our parent company and any other subsidiaries, joint venture partners or other companies that We control or that are under common control with Us.
  • With business partners: We may share Your Personal Data with Our business partners to offer You certain products, services or promotions.
  • With other users: If Our Service offers public areas, when You share Personal Data or otherwise interact in the public areas with other users, such information may be viewed by all users and may be publicly distributed outside.
  • With Your consent: We may disclose Your Personal Data for any other purpose with Your consent.

Retention of Your Personal Data

The Company will retain Your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use Your Personal Data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if We are required to retain Your data to comply with applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

Where possible, We apply shorter retention periods and/or reduce identifiability by deleting, aggregating, or anonymizing data. Unless otherwise stated, the retention periods below are maximum periods ("up to") and We may delete or anonymize data sooner when it is no longer needed for the relevant purpose. We apply different retention periods to different categories of Personal Data based on the purpose of processing and legal obligations:

  • Account Information
    • User Accounts: retained for the duration of your account relationship plus up to 24 months after account closure to handle any post-termination issues or resolve disputes.
  • Customer Support Data
    • Support tickets and correspondence: up to 24 months from the date of ticket closure to resolve follow-up inquiries, track service quality, and defend against potential legal claims
    • Chat transcripts: up to 24 months for quality assurance and staff training purposes.
  • Usage Data
    • Website analytics data (cookies, IP addresses, device identifiers): up to 24 months from the date of collection, which allows us to analyze trends while respecting privacy principles.
    • Server logs (IP addresses, access times): up to 24 months for security monitoring and troubleshooting purposes.

Usage Data is retained in accordance with the retention periods described above, and may be retained longer only where necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.

We may retain Personal Data beyond the periods stated above for different reasons:

  • Legal obligation: We are required by law to retain specific data (e.g., financial records for tax authorities).
  • Legal claims: Data is necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
  • Your explicit request: You ask Us to retain specific information.
  • Technical limitations: Data exists in backup systems that are scheduled for routine deletion.

You may request information about how long We will retain Your Personal Data by contacting Us.

When retention periods expire, We securely delete or anonymize Personal Data according to the following procedures:

  • Deletion: Personal Data is removed from Our systems and no longer actively processed.
  • Backup retention: Residual copies may remain in encrypted backups for a limited period consistent with our backup retention schedule and are not restored except where necessary for security, disaster recovery, or legal compliance.
  • Anonymization: In some cases, We convert Personal Data into anonymous statistical data that cannot be linked back to You. This anonymized data may be retained indefinitely for research and analytics.

Transfer of Your Personal Data

Your information, including Personal Data, is processed at the Company's operating offices and in any other places where the parties involved in the processing are located. It means that this information may be transferred to — and maintained on — computers located outside of Your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ from those from Your jurisdiction.

Where required by applicable law, We will ensure that international transfers of Your Personal Data are subject to appropriate safeguards and supplementary measures where appropriate. The Company will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that Your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy and no transfer of Your Personal Data will take place to an organization or a country unless there are adequate controls in place including the security of Your data and other personal information.

You have the right to delete or request that We assist in deleting the Personal Data that We have collected about You.

Our Service may give You the ability to delete certain information about You from within the Service.

You may update, amend, or delete Your information at any time by signing in to Your Account, if you have one, and visiting the account settings section that allows you to manage Your personal information. You may also contact Us to request access to, correct, or delete any Personal Data that You have provided to Us.

Please note, however, that We may need to retain certain information when we have a legal obligation or lawful basis to do so.

Disclosure of Your Personal Data

Business Transactions

If the Company is involved in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, Your Personal Data may be transferred. We will provide notice before Your Personal Data is transferred and becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.

Law enforcement

Under certain circumstances, the Company may be required to disclose Your Personal Data if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g. a court or a government agency).

Other legal requirements

The Company may disclose Your Personal Data in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to:

  • Comply with a legal obligation
  • Protect and defend the rights or property of the Company
  • Prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with the Service
  • Protect the personal safety of Users of the Service or the public
  • Protect against legal liability

Security of Your Personal Data

The security of Your Personal Data is important to Us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While We strive to use commercially reasonable means to protect Your Personal Data, We cannot guarantee its absolute security.

Children's Privacy

Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 16. If You are a parent or guardian and You are aware that Your child has provided Us with Personal Data, please contact Us. If We become aware that We have collected Personal Data from anyone under the age of 16 without verification of parental consent, We take steps to remove that information from Our servers.

If We need to rely on consent as a legal basis for processing Your information and Your country requires consent from a parent, We may require Your parent's consent before We collect and use that information.

Links to Other Websites

Our Service may contain links to other websites that are not operated by Us. If You click on a third party link, You will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise You to review the Privacy Policy of every site You visit.

We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third party sites or services.

Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update Our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify You of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

We will let You know via email and/or a prominent notice on Our Service, prior to the change becoming effective and update the "Last updated" date at the top of this Privacy Policy.

You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Intelligent Wellness. Elevated Living.

We are committed to delivering premium wellness technology with the highest standards of quality and service. To ensure complete customer confidence, the following return and refund terms apply.

Eligibility for Returns

Customers may request a return under the following conditions:

Defective or Damaged Products

If a product is delivered damaged, defective, or not functioning according to manufacturer specifications, the customer must notify within 48 hours of delivery.

Eligible cases include:

  • Manufacturing defects

  • Physical damage not caused by misuse

  • Incorrect product delivered

Upon verification, the product may be repaired, replaced, or refunded.

Change of Mind

Due to the nature of wellness machines and large equipment, returns for change of mind are subject to:

  • Request within 7 days of delivery

  • Product must be unused

  • Original packaging must be intact

  • All accessories, manuals, and components included

  • Product must not be installed

Once installation is completed, the product is considered used and not eligible for return.

Approved returns may include:

  • Inspection approval

  • Restocking fee (if applicable)

  • Deduction of delivery and installation charges

Non-Returnable Items

For hygiene, safety, and product integrity reasons, the following items are non-returnable unless defective:

  • Personal wellness gadgets once opened

  • Installed or used products

  • Customized or special-order items

  • Clearance or promotional items marked “Final Sale”

Inspection & Verification

All return requests are subject to technical inspection.

  • If a defect is confirmed:

    • Repair or replacement will be provided at no cost

    • If unavailable, a full refund will be issued

  • If no defect is found:

    • Product will be returned to the customer

    • Inspection or transport charges may apply

Refund Process

Approved refunds are processed within 7–14 business days via the original payment method.

Refunds may exclude:

  • Delivery charges

  • Installation fees

  • Restocking fees (if applicable)

For bank transfers or cash-on-delivery orders, valid bank details may be required.

Warranty

All products are covered by manufacturer warranty in accordance with standard industry practices.

Warranty covers:

  • Manufacturing defects

  • Technical malfunctions not caused by misuse

Warranty does not cover:

  • Damage from improper use

  • Electrical damage due to incorrect voltage

  • Unauthorized repairs or modifications

Installation & Acceptance

Upon installation and demonstration, the customer or authorized representative may be required to sign a delivery and acceptance form, confirming the product was received in good condition.

Compliance

All operations are conducted in accordance with applicable consumer protection laws. Customer rights are fully respected and protected.

How to Request a Return

To initiate a return request, please contact customer support and provide:

  • Order number

  • Product name

  • Description of the issue

  • Photos or videos (if applicable)

Our Commitment

Luxury is built on trust.
Trust is built on transparency.

Every purchase reflects a commitment to quality, integrity, and intelligent service.

item.title: 4D vs 3D vs 2D Massage Chairs: Which One Is Right for You?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Choosing a massage chair can feel overwhelming — especially when you see terms like 2D, 3D, and 4D technology. While they may sound technical, the difference directly affects comfort, massage intensity, realism, and price.

If you're planning to invest in a massage chair for pain relief, relaxation, or daily wellness, this guide will help you understand exactly which type suits your needs — and your budget.

What Do 2D, 3D, and 4D Mean in Massage Chairs?

These terms describe how the rollers move to mimic human hands.

2D Massage Chairs
Rollers move in two directions:

  • Up and down
  • Left and right

They provide a surface-level massage — great for relaxation but not deep tissue work.

3D Massage Chairs
Add a third dimension:

  • Rollers move inward and outward

This allows adjustable pressure and deeper muscle penetration.

4D Massage Chairs
Include everything in 3D plus:

  • Variable speed
  • Rhythm changes
  • Human-like pauses and patterns

This creates the most realistic massage experience available today.

Key Differences in Massage Depth, Motion, and Realism

If you want simple relaxation, 2D is enough.
For pain relief and muscle recovery, 3D or 4D works better.
For spa-level experience at home, 4D is unmatched.

Who Should Choose a 2D Massage Chair?

A 2D massage chair is ideal if you want comfort without spending heavily.

Best for:

  • First-time buyers
  • Seniors who prefer gentle massage
  • People who want daily relaxation
  • Budget-conscious households
  • Light back or neck stiffness

2D chairs provide soothing kneading and rolling — similar to a light spa session.

Models like your Heal Master 2D Massage Chair and Onyx 2D Massage Chair fit perfectly into this category, offering essential features at an affordable price.

Who Should Choose a 3D Massage Chair?

3D massage chairs strike the perfect balance between price and performance.

Best for:

  • Office workers with chronic back pain
  • People who sit long hours
  • Athletes needing muscle recovery
  • Families wanting one chair for everyone

Your Essence 3D Massage Chair is an excellent mid-range option that delivers noticeable relief without premium pricing.

With adjustable depth, you can choose between gentle relaxation or deeper therapy depending on your mood.

Why 4D Massage Chairs Offer the Most Human-Like Massage

4D chairs represent the latest innovation in home massage technology.

Unlike lower models, they simulate real therapist techniques by varying speed, intensity, and rhythm.

Best for:

  • Severe muscle tension or chronic pain
  • High-stress lifestyles
  • Athletes and fitness enthusiasts
  • Luxury home wellness setups
  • Buyers seeking spa-quality results at home

Features often include:

  • Body scanning technology
  • Zero-gravity positioning
  • Heating therapy
  • Advanced airbag systems
  • Personalized programs

Premium models like your ARISTO 4D Massage Chair deliver the closest experience to a professional massage session.

Price vs Value: Is Upgrading Worth It?

Many buyers wonder whether paying more actually makes a difference.

Here’s the truth:

  • 2D = Affordable comfort
  • 3D = Best overall value
  • 4D = Long-term investment in health

If you plan to use your chair daily — especially for pain relief — a higher-end model often pays off by reducing:

  • Physiotherapy visits
  • Spa expenses
  • Medication for muscle tension

Quick Recommendation Guide

Choose 2D if you want:
✔ Budget-friendly relaxation
✔ Gentle massage
✔ Simple operation

Choose 3D if you want:
✔ Stronger pressure options
✔ Family-friendly versatility
✔ Best balance of cost and performance

Choose 4D if you want:
✔ Professional-level therapy
✔ Maximum customization
✔ Premium comfort experience

item.title: Top Health Benefits of Using a Massage Chair at Home
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
In today’s fast-paced lifestyle, stress, back pain, and fatigue have become part of daily life. Long working hours, screen time, poor posture, and lack of physical activity all take a toll on the body. While spa visits offer temporary relief, they’re expensive and time-consuming.

A massage chair brings professional-level therapy into your home — available anytime you need it. From pain relief to better sleep, the benefits go far beyond simple relaxation.

Let’s explore why more households are investing in massage chairs as a long-term wellness solution.

Relief from Back Pain and Muscle Stiffness

Back pain is one of the most common health complaints worldwide — especially among office workers and people with sedentary lifestyles.

Massage chairs help by:

  • Loosening tight muscles
  • Reducing inflammation
  • Improving flexibility
  • Relieving pressure on the spine

Regular sessions can significantly reduce stiffness in the lower back, shoulders, and neck — areas most affected by prolonged sitting.

For those with mild to moderate pain, daily use may reduce dependence on pain medication and physiotherapy visits.

Improved Blood Circulation & Muscle Recovery

Massage stimulates blood flow throughout the body, delivering oxygen and nutrients to muscles and tissues.

Benefits include:

  • Faster recovery after workouts
  • Reduced swelling in legs and feet
  • Prevention of muscle cramps
  • Improved energy levels

Zero-gravity positioning — available in many modern chairs — elevates the legs above the heart, enhancing circulation even further.

This is particularly beneficial for people who stand all day, travel frequently, or experience leg fatigue.

Stress Reduction and Better Sleep Quality

Chronic stress affects both physical and mental health. Massage therapy activates the body’s relaxation response by lowering cortisol levels and promoting endorphin release.

Regular use can:

  • Calm the nervous system
  • Reduce anxiety
  • Improve mood
  • Help you fall asleep faster
  • Enhance sleep quality

Many users report that a short session before bedtime leads to deeper, more restorative sleep.

How Daily Massage Supports Posture Correction

Poor posture from desk work or mobile use can lead to chronic pain and long-term spinal issues.

Massage chairs help correct posture by:

  • Relaxing overworked muscles
  • Strengthening underused muscle groups
  • Aligning the spine during sessions
  • Reducing tension in shoulders and neck

Advanced chairs with body-scan technology adjust to your height and spine shape, ensuring targeted therapy where you need it most.

Massage Chair vs Visiting a Spa: Cost Comparison

While spa massages feel luxurious, they quickly become expensive over time.

Typical spa visit costs:

  • Weekly massage sessions
  • Travel time and scheduling
  • Tips and add-on services

A massage chair is a one-time investment that provides unlimited sessions for the entire family.

Over a few years, it can save thousands while offering greater convenience and privacy.

Who Should Use a Massage Chair? (Age-Wise Guide)

Massage chairs are suitable for a wide range of users:

Young Adults (20–35)

  • Fitness recovery
  • Stress management
  • Preventing posture problems

Working Professionals (30–55)

  • Back and neck pain relief
  • Relaxation after long workdays
  • Improved productivity

Older Adults (55+)

  • Joint stiffness reduction
  • Circulation support
  • Gentle daily therapy

Most modern chairs offer adjustable intensity levels, making them safe and comfortable for different age groups.

Best Chair Features to Look For in 2026

If you’re planning to buy a massage chair, prioritize features that deliver real therapeutic value:

  • ✔ Zero-gravity positioning
  • ✔ Heating therapy for muscles
  • ✔ Full-body airbag compression
  • ✔ Foot and calf massage rollers
  • ✔ Body scanning technology
  • ✔ Multiple auto programs
  • ✔ Adjustable intensity levels

These features ensure you get both relaxation and long-term health benefits.

🧘 Final Thoughts

A massage chair is more than a comfort device — it’s an investment in your physical and mental well-being.

With regular use, you may experience:

✅ Reduced pain and stiffness
✅ Better circulation
✅ Lower stress levels
✅ Improved posture
✅ Deeper sleep
✅ Enhanced quality of life

Instead of waiting for discomfort to build up, daily massage can help your body recover, recharge, and perform at its best — all from the comfort of your home.

item.title: Foot Massagers vs Massage Chairs: Which One Do You Really Need?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
When it comes to relaxation and pain relief at home, two popular options dominate the market: electric foot massagers and full-body massage chairs. Both offer impressive health benefits — but they serve very different needs.

If you’re trying to decide which one is right for you (or whether you should start with a foot massager before upgrading), this guide will help you make the smartest choice.

Why Foot Massage Is Essential for Whole-Body Wellness

Your feet carry your entire body weight every day. They contain thousands of nerve endings connected to different organs and muscle groups.

Regular foot massage can:

  • Reduce foot pain and fatigue
  • Improve overall relaxation
  • Stimulate pressure points (reflexology)
  • Support circulation in lower limbs
  • Relieve swelling after long standing hours

For many people, simply relaxing the feet leads to full-body stress relief.

🔹 Key Benefits of Electric Foot Massagers

Electric foot massagers are compact, affordable, and surprisingly powerful.

Major advantages include:

✔ Deep kneading for soles and heels
✔ Air compression for ankles and calves
✔ Heat therapy for muscle relaxation
✔ Easy storage and portability
✔ Quick sessions anytime

They are especially useful for people who don’t need full-body massage but suffer from tired feet or leg discomfort.

👉 Devices like your D-Queen SPA Electric Foot Massager provide targeted relief without requiring a large space or major investment.

🔹 When a Foot Massager Is Better Than a Full Massage Chair

A foot massager can be the smarter choice in many situations.

Choose a foot massager if you:

  • Live in a small apartment
  • Have limited budget
  • Only experience foot or leg pain
  • Travel frequently
  • Want something portable
  • Prefer short relaxation sessions

It’s also a great entry-level wellness device before committing to a larger purchase.

🔹 Who Should Buy a Foot Massager?

Foot massagers are particularly beneficial for certain lifestyles and health needs.

Ideal users include:

👩‍⚕️ Healthcare workers who stand all day
👨‍💼 Office workers with poor circulation
👵 Seniors with joint stiffness
🛍️ Retail employees and teachers
🏃 Fitness enthusiasts recovering after workouts
🧳 Frequent travelers with swollen feet

For people with diabetes or circulation issues, gentle foot massage can also help reduce discomfort — though medical advice is recommended.

Foot Massager vs Built-in Chair Foot Rollers

Massage chairs often include foot and calf massage features — but they serve a different purpose.

Foot Massager

  • Focused, intense therapy
  • Adjustable positioning
  • Portable and compact
  • Usually stronger for soles

Massage Chair Foot Section

  • Integrated into full-body session
  • More convenient but less targeted
  • Designed for overall relaxation
  • Cannot be used separately

If foot pain is your primary concern, a dedicated device usually delivers better results.

How Often Should You Use a Foot Massager?

For most people, safe daily use ranges between:

  • 10–20 minutes per session
  • 1–2 times per day

Regular use may help:

  • Reduce swelling
  • Improve circulation
  • Ease chronic foot fatigue
  • Promote relaxation after work

Always start with lower intensity and increase gradually.

Budget-Friendly Relaxation: A Smart First Purchase

Massage chairs are a major investment, while foot massagers provide many benefits at a fraction of the cost.

They are perfect if you want:

✔ Immediate pain relief
✔ Affordable home wellness solution
✔ A gift for parents or loved ones
✔ A compact device for daily use
✔ A trial step before buying a massage chair

Many households start with a foot massager — then upgrade later once they experience the benefits of regular massage therapy.

Final Thoughts

Both devices offer excellent health benefits, but the right choice depends on your needs, space, and budget.

Choose a Foot Massager if you want:

✅ Targeted relief for feet and legs
✅ Portability and convenience
✅ Budget-friendly option
✅ Quick daily relaxation

Choose a Massage Chair if you want:

✅ Full-body therapy
✅ Deep muscle relief
✅ Advanced features
✅ Long-term wellness investment

If foot fatigue is your biggest issue, a high-quality electric foot massager may be all you need to feel refreshed, relaxed, and pain-free every day.

Experience a new era of Relaxation and Restoration with the Essence Massage Chair. More than just a chair it's your personal haven, designed to follow the natural curves of your body and target key acupressure points with the latest technology. The Essence Massage Chair offers a range of soothing techniques to help you relax deeply, relieve tension, improve circulation and more.

Forget these Problems

  • Poor spine health and posture issues
  • Reduced blood circulation
  • Body chills due to lack of warmth
  • Persistent back pain
  • High levels of stress and tension
  • Fatigue and soreness in tired muscles

Luxurious Design

 Premium Full-Body Synthetic Leather Wrapped in high-quality synthetic leather, the Essence Massage Chair feels as good as it looks, from headrest to footrest.

LED Touch Screen Control Panel Effortlessly adjust your settings with a sleek, intuitive LED touch screen.

The Essence Massage Chair offers a complete wellness experience that combines comfort, relaxation and luxury every day.

item.title: ARISTO 4D Massage Chair
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded:
The ARISTO 4D Massage Chair by Zero Healthcare is a smart full-body wellness system designed to relax, realign and recharge you right at your place. Its advanced  massage technology, dynamic ankle flipping mechanism and custom intensity controls work together to release tension, support recovery and improve daily comfort. From head to feet, ARISTO adapts to your needs and offers relief where your body needs it most.

Signature Features – Explained Simply & Specifically

Ankle Flipping Adjustment – Precision Fit for Every Leg Type

Traditional leg massage systems are fixed. ARISTO features a dynamic ankle flipping mechanism that manually or automatically adjusts the ankle rest angle. – This system works through pivoted brackets and jointed actuators that allow up-down flipping movement of the ankle section. – The flipping helps align your ankles to match your sitting height and leg shape which increases contact during calf and foot massage. – Combined with foot rollers and airbags to ensure complete 360° lower leg therapy. Your feet and calves don’t just rest they get actively treated.

Arm Tapping + Air Compression – Stimulation, Not Just Squeeze

Unlike basic air-only chairs, ARISTO combines mechanical tapping units under the armrest with strategically placed airbags. – The tapping motors simulate rhythmic tapping strokes to stimulate muscle reflexes. – Simultaneously, airbags inflate and deflate in timed cycles, hugging your arms from wrist to elbow. – The result is a balanced pressure and percussion combo that enhances blood circulation, reduces fatigue and loosens joint stiffness. Perfect for those who type, lift or drive all day.

Back & Calf Heating – Heat That Heals Where It Hurts

ARISTO includes built-in carbon fiber heating pads behind the backrest and within the calf area. – These pads emit far-infrared heat, which penetrates below the skin level to warm muscles from the inside out. – This mechanism increases local blood circulation which helps with detoxification, and relieves tightness. – The warmth activates gradually during your session to complement the massage pressure. It’s not surface heat, it’s therapeutic warmth where your body needs it most.

Backrest Up & Down – Recline How You Like It

ARISTO comes with a motorized reclining system connected to the backrest frame. – A quiet linear actuator lifts or lowers the backrest at the push of a button (or voice command). – This allows the user to adjust from upright seated posture to near-horizontal recline. – It’s not just about angle it's about posture support, pressure relief and comfort during various activities like reading, watching or resting. Your spine stays supported, no matter how far you lean back.

Wellness Benefits

  1. Eases back, shoulder, leg and arm pain
  2. Relieves stress, improves sleep quality
  3. Boosts blood circulation and flexibility
  4. Warms up tight muscles & reduces inflammation
  5. Encourages lymphatic drainage
  6. Helps regulate posture & spinal alignment
  7. Offers full-body support for daily recovery
  8. Great for desk workers, elderly users & athletes

Who Should Use It?

Ideal for:

  • Office workers with neck, shoulder or lower back stiffness
  • Athletes with sore muscles or post-training recovery needs
  • Elderly users with circulation or joint stiffness
  • Women facing leg fatigue or body soreness from standing work
  • People with sedentary lifestyles or poor posture
  • Individuals with stress, insomnia or anxiety-related tension

Best for These Specific Conditions

ARISTO is particularly suitable for:

  • Cervical & Lumbar Pain
  • Sciatica
  • Muscle Fatigue & Stiffness
  • Frozen Shoulder
  • Stress-Related Insomnia
  • Mild Osteoarthritis
  • Poor Leg Circulation (e.g. Edema, Fatigue) Including patients recovering from long-term muscular strain or minor spinal misalignments.
